title: Discrete Derivative
text: Compute discrete-time derivative, 1 input, 1 output, direct feedthrough, {Integer rounding mode} sets Rounding mode for fixed-point operations; {Gain value} sets the scaling factor, {Initial condition for previous weighted input K*u/Ts}, {Input processing} sets the sample- or frame-based processing Elements, {Output minimum} sets the minimum output value for range checking, {Output maximum} sets the maximum output value for range checking, {Output data type}, {Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools} sets the option to prevent fixed-point tools from overriding Output data and {Saturate to max or min when overflows occur} sets the method of overflow action. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Scaled discrete time derivative scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Initial condition for previous weighted input K*u/Ts
Input processing
params.values: Specify sample- or frame-based processing Elements as channels (sample based) (default) | Columns as channels (frame based)

params.name: Output minimum
params.values: Minimum output value for range checking [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Output maximum
params.values: Maximum output value for range checking [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Output data type Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Inherit via back propagation | double | single | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 | int64 | uint64 | fixdt(1,16,0) | fixdt(1,16,2^0,0)

params.name: Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Option to prevent fixed-point tools from overriding Output data type off (default) | on

params.name: Integer rounding mode
params.values: Rounding mode for fixed-point operations Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate to max or min when overflows occur
params.values: Method of overflow action off (default) | on
